Persistent Storage for AI Apps: Database, Disk, or Object Storage?

Quick thread 🧵
An AI app has four kinds of state.
Structured records (users, conversations, app state, and embeddings) go in a managed database, Postgres by default, with pgvector holding the embeddings.
Files (uploads, RAG source documents, generated images) go in S3-compatible object storage.
Sessions, counters, and cached answers go in Redis with TTLs.
